findings: The host mounts a swap's panel inside the flush that delivers the click: 0 frames after the flush in every steady swap of the headless lane.

A swap that creates 100 nodes costs 9.2 ms of CPU at the median and 12.4 at p95 in the headless loop (pooled over the two processes), more than one 120 Hz period (8.33 ms); earlier development runs on a more loaded machine gave 11 to 12 ms at the median (not pinned).
A View hidden with display none adds no node to the SceneTree, the host or the Surface (the first leaky-panel sabotage used it and was not rejected); the retained variant uses opacity 0.
A reading of Hermes' heap can carry a transient allocation of 2,056 bytes (one to three consecutive rounds), which is why the heap at rest is judged on the floor of windows of five rounds.
A window can draw, with frame_post_draw firing and the vsync mode reading enabled, while no display paces the loop (an idle frame of 0.7 ms): the windowed lane now refuses such runs.

windowedLane.status: not presented: unpaced: the display is not presenting (slot 1, 3 attempts)
windowedLane.explanation: The lane ran while the Mac had been idle for about 96 minutes (HIDIdleTime) and the display was off or showing the lock screen. Every attempt drew (frame_post_draw fired after 99.9% of the process frames) and the vsync mode read back enabled at 120 Hz, but no display paced the loop: an idle frame took 0.7 ms at the median against the 4.167 ms (half of the 120 Hz period) that the validity rule requires. The three attempts of slot 1 were rejected as unpaced, the lane stopped, and the receipt carries no frame-time statistic.

protocol.percentiles: nearest rank over the raw intervals of one run
protocol.acrossRuns: median and interquartile range (nearest-rank quartiles) of each run's statistic
protocol.validity: a run counts only if the window drew throughout (a frame after every steady click and nine of ten in the idle window) and its idle frame median is at least half of the refresh period read back; any other run is rejected with its reason, kept in rejectedAttempts and repeated; a slot that exhausts its attempts ends the lane as not presented, with no frame-time statistic
protocol.discarded: the warm-up rounds, and the rejected attempts; every interval of every accepted run is in raw, and every rejected attempt is kept in rejectedAttempts

The intervals are of process frames. With the vsync on they come in clusters (the engine runs ahead of the display and blocks on it), so a missed frame is not read from them; missed frames with the vsync on need presentation timestamps this engine does not give.

decisions: The swap is measured as a real click through the pointer spike's own injection, preloaded and not copied, on the pointer spike's scene unchanged.
Exact invariants are judged in headless; durations, memory and the frames a click takes are recorded and never judged.
The heap at rest is read after 30 idle frames and judged on the floor of windows of five steady rounds against the GF-30 limit (a transient of 2,056 bytes exists).

Frame time exists only in a windowed lane that a display presents; a run is rejected as unpaced when its idle frame median is under half of the refresh period read back. The lane then ends with presented false, exit code 3 and no frame-time statistic.
No missed frame is read from process-frame intervals, because with the vsync on they come in clusters.
limitations: Local macOS arm64 evidence; hosted CI is pending and the windowed lane is local only.
The events are synthetic, delivered through Input.parse_input_event: no hardware pointer, no real touch screen, no iPhone, no mobile export.
One machine under load from other agents (the load average is recorded before and after every command), one display, one vsync mode (the default, enabled, read back).

The frame time of a presented window (vsync on, 120 Hz) is PENDING: no windowed attempt was presented by the display, so no frame-time statistic is pinned and the frame-dependent rows of the budget are PENDING. No FPS without a limit is claimed.
No presentation timestamps: missed frames with the vsync on stay open (the ROADMAP's V05-10 metric).
The HUD is a fixture of the Frontier panels' shape (V05-05 is open), not the Frontier HUD; panels with images, text inputs, scroll views or animations are not measured.
The turno, soak and congelado criteria of V05-06 are open; the proposed budget is not frozen.
Previous-host control: not applicable, the slice changes no C++.
